meta.title: Fixed Broadband Subscriptions
meta.summary: Fixed (wired or fixed-wireless) internet subscriptions of at least 256 kbit/s per 100 people: DSL, cable, fibre, satellite and fixed wireless, homes and businesses together; mobile data is not included. A subscription usually serves a whole household, so 40 per 100 can mean nearly every home is connected. Reported by national regulators and operators to the ITU; the most recent years are missing for many countries until ITU fills them in.
meta.source: World Bank Open Data (World Development Indicators)
